errors.evidence: The reference description explicitly states that the chart illustrates accuracy percentages for different methods across three categories (Mathverse, MMLU, Physics). The machine-generated description omits this core purpose and instead vaguely refers to 'performance of different reinforcement learning (RL) methods'.

The reference describes the y-axis as representing 'Accuracy (%)' with a linear scale from 50% to 62% and tick intervals of 2%. The machine-generated description omits the y-axis label, scale, and tick intervals entirely.

The x-axis does have a categorical label structure, though it is not explicitly labeled as a single overarching term. The machine-generated description incorrectly claims there is no general label for the x-axis.
The reference specifies the three categories on the x-axis as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The machine-generated description mentions 'three domains' but does not name them explicitly.

The reference does not indicate that the categories are arranged in random order; they are presented in a consistent, deliberate sequence (Mathverse, MMLU, Physics). The machine-generated description incorrectly describes the order as arbitrary.

The reference describes six color-coded and patterned bars per category, corresponding to DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO. The machine-generated description omits all mention of the legend, bar patterns, and color coding.

The reference provides specific accuracy values for key bars (e.g., DAPO+Self-reflection in Mathverse at ~56%, DAPO+Self-reflection in Physics at ~61%). The machine-generated description omits all numerical values.
The reference mentions that there is no additional visual emphasis (e.g., bolding or highlighting) on any bars. The machine-generated description does not address this point.
The image does not contain a figure number or title (e.g., 'Фигура 5'). This information is hallucinated by the machine-generated description.
The description incorrectly maps the solid blue bar to DAPO, but the figure shows solid blue corresponds to DAPO + Self-reflection. DAPO is represented by blue with diagonal stripes.
The description incorrectly maps the striped blue bar to DAPO + Self-reflection, but the figure shows striped blue corresponds to DAPO. DAPO + Self-reflection is represented by solid blue.
The description incorrectly maps the solid orange bar to GRPO, but the figure shows solid orange corresponds to SRPO. GRPO is represented by orange with diagonal stripes.

The description incorrectly maps the solid olive green bar to SRPO, but the figure does not use olive green. SRPO is represented by solid orange. Additionally, the color description 'olive green' is incorrect for any bar in the figure.
The description incorrectly maps the solid dark green bar to PPO, but the figure shows solid dark green corresponds to PPO + Self-reflection. PPO is represented by green with diagonal stripes.
The description reports ~56.1% for the solid blue bar (DAPO + Self-reflection in the figure), but the figure shows this value as 56% for Mathverse, not an average or general value.

The description reports ~54.8% for the striped blue bar (DAPO in the figure), but the figure shows this value as 53% for Mathverse, 55.9% for MMLU, and 58.5% for Physics. The value ~54.8% is not accurate for any task.

The description reports ~52.5% for the solid orange bar (SRPO in the figure), but the figure shows SRPO values as 55.7% for Mathverse, 57.3% for MMLU, and 60.4% for Physics. The value ~52.5% is incorrect.
The description reports ~55% for SRPO, but the figure shows SRPO values as 55.7%, 57.3%, and 60.4% for the three tasks. The value ~55% is an oversimplification and does not match any specific task.

The description reports ~54.2% for the solid dark green bar (PPO + Self-reflection in the figure), but the figure shows this value as 54.5% for Mathverse, 56.1% for MMLU, and 59.1% for Physics. The value ~54.2% is not accurate for any task.

The description mentions 'Striped orange' as a category, but the figure does not include any orange striped bars. GRPO is represented by orange with diagonal stripes, but the description does not explicitly mention this for any value.
The description does not state what the chart represents (accuracy performance of different methods across three tasks).
The description omits the x-axis labels (Mathverse, MMLU, Physics) and the y-axis label (Accuracy (%)), as well as the scale and range of the y-axis.
The description does not mention the presence of six distinct methods per task, the grouping of bars by task, or the specific values for each task (only vague approximations are provided).
The description omits the legend and the specific visual attributes (e.g., solid vs. striped bars) for all methods except for a few incorrectly mapped ones.
The description introduces 'olive green' as a color, which does not exist in the figure. The figure uses solid orange for SRPO.

The reference description explicitly states the chart illustrates accuracy percentages for different methods across three categories, while the machine-generated description only mentions 'performance of various Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods' without specifying accuracy.
The reference description specifies the y-axis scale ranges from 50% to 62% with tick intervals of 2%, which is missing in the machine-generated description.

The machine-generated description omits the legend details, including the six color-coded and patterned bars (DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, PPO) and their visual attributes (solid colors and diagonal stripes).

The reference description mentions specific accuracy values for each method in each category (e.g., DAPO+Self-reflection in Mathverse reaches ~53%, Physics reaches ~61%), which are missing in the machine-generated description.
The reference description notes that three bars have diagonal stripes, which is not mentioned in the machine-generated description.

The reference description correctly identifies the chart as a bar chart with grouped bars, but the term 'grouped vertical bar chart' is redundant since bar charts are vertical by default unless specified otherwise.
